reply_text:
Nadia, Gideon landed on 280 seats for Vantorre Group in his 1 July update. I've replied in your thread in #strategic-pod.

He first said 300, then corrected it a few minutes later. The 300 came from a staging tab that included sandbox logins from their May rollout. The 280 is the active production roster as of 1 July, and Ruth acknowledged it.

Gideon's correction calls it "Nadia's old industrial account" rather than naming Vantorre Group. It comes right after his Vantorre update, so I read it as the same account. That's worth a quick check before you update the roster sheet. The 280 is also the July figure, so it may have changed since.
